status: recommended final evaluation; not yet executed

qwen_model_card.BFCL_for_exact_checkpoint: Not found in the official model card; do not substitute a third-party or another checkpoint score
qwen_model_card.IFBench_protocol_limit: The model card gives a score but does not specify strict vs loose scoring, repeats, or a complete IFBench-specific recipe; exact reproduction must not be assumed.

BFCL.purpose: Tool choice, arguments, relevance, multi-turn state and recovery; web-search is relevant but adds live-service dependencies

IFBench.purpose: Verifiable instruction following; complements rather than establishes tool-use helpfulness
IFBench.official_reporting: Paper generally uses prompt-level loose accuracy, temperature zero, final answer excluding reasoning; report strict too

design.freeze: Freeze neuron identities and benchmark versions before generating benchmark responses; do not tune on benchmark failures
design.comparisons: Same weights, precision, prompts, decoding, context budget and tools with ablation off versus on
design.primary_tool_metrics: BFCL category scores and official weighted aggregate only if full required suite is run; label subsets explicitly
design.secondary: IFBench strict and loose prompt accuracy; truncation and output length
design.uncertainty: Paired per-item changes and confidence intervals; report benchmark-specific claims
design.noninferiority: Choose a practically acceptable loss margin and power calculation before runs; absence of significance is not evidence of no regression
design.published_baseline: Context only unless official Qwen recipe is fully reproduced; own matched unsteered baseline is causal comparator
design.budget: Cost the frozen suite before launching within the remaining $100 session cap
